name: X'mas Present
source:
Two semesters till Christmas. There is premonition that something new is bound to happen. There is a choice among three stories, each featuring a different narration with a different girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
距离圣诞节还有两个学期。有一种预感，即将发生新的事情。共有三个故事可供选择，每个故事都有不同女孩的不同叙述。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
